cap-add-term.description:
Add a word, term, or expression to a named vocabulary domain. Use it when the user asks to add or save a term to their vocabulary, glossary, or vocabulary list. It does not apply to creating files or folders or editing existing file content.

中文：把一个词、术语或表达收进用户词汇库（生词本、术语表、词库里的某个命名域）。当用户要求将某个词、术语或表达加入/收录到词汇库的指定命名域时适用。它只新增一条词汇记录；新建文件或文件夹、修改已有文件的内容，都不属于它。

term.description: the word/term to add, quotes removed

domain.description: the vocabulary domain to add it into

cap-artifact.description:
Compile a research artifact into a formally published PDF. Use it when the user explicitly asks to compile, generate, or publish research results as a final PDF artifact. It does not apply to ordinary slide decks, summaries, or mind maps.

中文：将研究成果物编译为正式发布的 PDF。当用户明确要求将研究成果编译、生成或发布为正式 PDF 成果物时适用。普通幻灯片、摘要、思维导图不属于它。

action.description: Which action to run. One of: compile_pdf, status.

run_id.description: status: the compile run id; compile_pdf: optional replay id override.

project_id.description: compile_pdf: research project whose primary manuscript is compiled.

cap-bash.description:
Execute a command or script in the workspace sandbox. Use it when the user explicitly asks to run or execute a command or script. It does not apply when the user only wants to read a file or edit file contents.

中文：在工作区沙箱中执行用户明确要求运行的命令或脚本。当用户要求“运行／执行某条命令或脚本”时适用。只想读取文件、或只想修改文件内容而没有要求执行命令的，都不属于它。

cap-create-folder.description:
Create a new folder with an explicit name in the workspace. Use it when the user asks to create or make a folder or directory. It does not apply to creating or editing files, renaming existing folders, or adding terms to a vocabulary domain.

中文：新建一个名称明确的文件夹（目录、子文件夹）。当用户要求“新建／创建文件夹”时适用。新建文档或文件、给已有文件夹改名、把词收进词汇库，都不属于它。

cap-edit-file.description:
Modify the contents of an existing workspace-local file. Use it when the user asks to change, replace, update, or write content in an existing file. It does not apply to only reading a file, creating a folder, or adding a term to a vocabulary domain.

中文：修改工作区里某个已存在文件的内容——替换其中一段文字，或写入新内容。当用户要求“改动／更新／替换某个文件里的内容”时适用。只读取文件、新建文件夹、把词存进词汇库，都不属于它。

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, or a drive path "My Drive/<path>".

cap-mindmap.description:
Create a Mermaid mind map (.mmd) from one or more workspace files. Use it when the user asks for a mind map, brain map, or knowledge tree. It does not apply to producing a written summary, slide deck, or published research PDF.

中文：把一个或多个工作区文件的内容整理成分支结构的 Mermaid 思维导图（.mmd）。当用户要“思维导图／脑图／知识树”时适用。要文字摘要、幻灯片或正式 PDF 成果物的，都不属于它。

cap-pdf-extract-text.description:
Extract the complete raw text from an attached or resolved document. Use it when the user asks to extract or export the document's full text. It does not apply to extracting only tables or to reading and understanding the document for question answering.

中文：提取附件/已解析文档的完整原始文字内容。当用户要求提取全文或导出文档原始文字时适用。只转换表格的应交给表格转换；要求理解、阅读并据此回答问题的，不属于它。

pages.description: optional page spec like "2" or "1-3" from the viewer context; omitted = whole document

asset_id.description: asset id of the attached/opened document (from turn facts, not the sentence)

cap-pdf-table-to-text.description:
Convert tables inside an attached PDF into text while preserving their row and column structure. Use it when the user explicitly asks to convert PDF tables to text or CSV. It does not apply to extracting the full document text.

中文：只把附件 PDF 里的表格转换为文字，并保留行列结构。当用户明确要求“把这份 PDF 里的表格转成文字／CSV”时适用。提取整份文档的全文不属于它。

pages.description: optional page spec like "2" or "1-3" from the viewer context; omitted = whole document

asset_id.description: asset id of the attached/opened document (from turn facts, not the sentence)

cap-rag-search.description:
Search the user's own imported materials or document library. Use it when the user asks to find information in their imported or uploaded materials. It does not apply to public-web search or social-platform search.

中文：在用户自己导入的材料（个人文档库、已上传的资料）里检索内容。当用户要在“我导入的资料／我的资料库”中查找某个问题时适用。搜索公开网络、或搜索社交平台，都不属于它。

query.description: the user's search TOPIC, extracted from the sentence and kept VERBATIM — do not rewrite, translate, summarize, expand or paraphrase

top_k.description: optional result count; only when the sentence states one

domain.description: optional domain NAME to scope the search to (resolved to a real domain id by the tool); only when the sentence names one

cap-read-document.description:
Read and understand the structured content of a resolved document asset. Use it when the user asks to read a document and answer questions based on its contents. It does not apply to exporting the document's raw text, extracting only tables, or reading a workspace-local file by path.

中文：阅读当前附件或阅读器中已打开的那份文档的结构化内容，可用于回答关于该文档的问题。当用户要“读这份文档／通读它并据此作答”时适用。把文档原文整段导出、或只转表格，都不属于它；按路径读工作区里的普通文件也不属于它。

pages.description: page/slide spec "2" or "1-3"; only if stated

asset_id.description: ID of the attached or opened document, obtained from turn facts, not the user's sentence

cap-read-file.description: Read the contents of an existing file from the workspace or My Drive using its path. It does not apply to attachments or viewer documents, or to image analysis.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, or a drive path "My Drive/<path>".

cap-slides.description:
Create a slide deck with a canonical 16:9 PDF plus Marp and .pptx exports. Use it when the user asks for slides, a presentation, or a PowerPoint deck. It does not apply to summaries, mind maps, or published research PDF artifacts.

中文：把材料做成幻灯片：输出正式的 16:9 PDF，并同时导出 Marp 与 .pptx。当用户要“PPT／演示文稿／slides”时适用。要摘要、思维导图或研究 PDF 成果物的，都不属于它。

cap-social-search.description:
Search social platforms such as Reddit for discussions, recommendations, and user opinions. Use it when the user asks what people or online communities are saying on a social platform. It does not apply to general public-web search or searches over the user's own materials.

中文：在 Reddit 等社交平台上搜索大家的讨论、推荐与评价。当用户点名社交平台，或要“社区／论坛里大家怎么说、网友评价”时适用。一般网页搜索、搜索用户自己的资料，都不属于它。

limit.description: max results per platform; only if stated

query.description: search query copied verbatim from the user's sentence; do not rewrite, translate, summarize, expand or paraphrase

platform.description: platform reddit / x / zhihu; omit unless named

cap-summary.description:
Generate a grounded Markdown research summary with [file:line] citations. Use it when the user asks to summarize, condense, or extract key points from the available research materials. It does not apply to creating slides, mind maps, translations, or published research PDF artifacts.

中文：把本轮材料提炼成带有出处的 Markdown 摘要。当用户要“总结／概括要点／提炼重点”时适用。要幻灯片、思维导图、翻译或研究 PDF 成果物的，都不属于它。

cap-translate.description:
Translate provided text from one language into another. Use it when the user explicitly asks to translate text into a different language. It does not apply to summarizing, explaining, or rewriting text in the same language.

中文：把给定文本从一种语言翻译成另一种语言。当用户要求“翻译成某种语言”时适用，附件或引用中的文字同样可以翻译。要求总结、解释或同语言改写的，都不属于它。

text.description: the text to translate, copied from the sentence

target_language.description: optional target language name (e.g. "English", "Chinese"); omitted -> executor default (English)

cap-vision.description:
Analyze an image (screenshot, chart, photo, diagram). Use it when the user asks what an image contains or means. Not for reading text documents or extracting PDF text.

中文：分析附件或阅读器中的图片（截图、图表、照片、示意图），回答图里有什么或表达什么。不适用于 PDF 或文本文档。

page.description: 1-based PDF page to render and read; omitted -> the page open in the viewer (a multi-page PDF with no page in view is refused)

region.description: optional sub-region of the rendered page as fractions {x, y, w, h} (0..1, top-left origin)

asset_id.description: asset id of the attached/opened image (from turn facts, not the sentence)

question.description: optional question about the image, copied from the sentence

cap-web-search.description:
Search the public web for external information, including webpages, reference material, news, and current information. Use it when the user asks to search or look up information on the internet. It does not apply to searching the user's own materials or searches restricted to a specific social platform.

中文：在公开互联网上搜索外部信息，包括网页、资料、新闻和时事。当用户要求上网查找公开网络信息时适用。搜索用户自己的资料或限定在特定社交平台上搜索，不属于它。

query.description: the user's search TOPIC, extracted from the sentence and kept VERBATIM — do not rewrite, translate, summarize, expand or paraphrase

top_k.description: optional number of results; only when the sentence states one
